author: rocksoffjagger
body: Achievements and play while being driven (as a passenger) in a car so you can fight tons of bosses. When grinding this way, make sure to use lucky coin, lucky silver coin, dowsing rod, shrines, and orn boosting gear for maximum rewards.

author: pangarma
body: Go for a ride and pop every orn bonus and equip any you can and kill bosses

author: OldKid1975
body: If none of the above are an option then the pvp arena is a good place.

author: Specialist_Winner521
body: From personal experience as a passenger in a vehicle(NOT A DRIVER) I tend to get 30-70k orns a day from my day to day commutes as a passenger just killing every boss I can and complete as many quests as possible

author: WrongLine1093
body:
some days i manage up to 8 million orns  
but that means sitting down and letting you drive.  
bus, train, ship  
my brother is a truck driver and sometimes i sit next to him and play up to 6 hours just farming bosses. but unfortunately it happens too rarely.   
what also goes very well -> try to lvl as fast as possible. the higher you get the stronger the monsters become. lv1- lv50 monsters bring so on average from 1 orn to felt 50 orns. the current monsters I kill (lv 250) can drop up to 1350 orns - without buffs.  
if i have complete orns-farm-set on - drops up to 7k orns from berserk-arisen monsters, a few times it happens that bosses drop up to 21k orns
